subject: Scaling Event — promo allowance request
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@brightfoundry.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: events@brightfoundry.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Promo allowance request for 'Scaling' webinar

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re doing well — we wanted to check on the possibility of a small promo allowance for our Oct 28 webinar (Scaling Product with LLMs). We’re expecting ~420 registrants and would like to offer a limited trial experience to attendees so they can try Redwood on their own datasets.

Specifically we’re asking for:
- 500 trial tokens (one-time codes or unique single-use tokens) to be distributed to registrants
- 90-day trial length from redemption date
- Per-account cap: 1 redemption per company/email

Can you confirm if this is feasible and whether you need a registrant export or additional info by Monday (Oct 26)? Happy to share an attendee CSV.

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Reed
Partnerships, BrightFoundry
[Attachment: webinar_reg_list.csv]
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@brightfoundry.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-21T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo allowance request for 'Scaling' webinar

Thanks for the details, Taylor — this is doable in principle. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can get the ops flow right: 

1) Do you want a single shared code for all attendees or unique single-use codes? Unique codes are preferred on our side to prevent abuse but require a short upload step.
2) Will attendees be invited to create a Redwood account (email) or redeem anonymously? Our default enforcement is one redemption per email.
3) Are you expecting any sponsored demo accounts (i.e., internal BrightFoundry team accounts) that should be excluded from counts?

Marissa — we may need your signoff on the promo allowance and the redemption cap. Ben — could you advise if we need a formal finance approval or if Growth can approve up to 500 promo tokens?

Taylor, if you can confirm (1)-(3) and share the attendee CSV, we’ll prepare either a codes CSV or a single coupon and send over usage window + redemption terms.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Growth Operations, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@brightfoundry.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo allowance request for 'Scaling' webinar

Looping in here — Growth can approve up to 500 trial tokens for partner webinars provided:
- Single redemption per unique email (enforced at redemption)
- Codes expire 90 days from issuance
- We receive the registrant list 48 hours before the event for reconciliation

Ben — finance — please confirm budget ok for treating this as a marketing promo (no chargeback expected).

I’m attaching a template codes CSV we can populate if BrightFoundry wants unique codes. If they want a single coupon, we’ll supply the coupon code and a usage cap.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: codes_template.csv]
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@brightfoundry.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-23T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo allowance request for 'Scaling' webinar

Hi Taylor — thanks for the quick answers earlier and for the attendee CSV. We’ve approved a batch of 500 single-use trial tokens with the following terms: 

- One redemption per unique email
- 90-day validity from redemption
- Codes expire if not redeemed by 2027-01-21

Attachments: codes_20261021.csv (single-use tokens, 1 row per code) and a short usage checklist. Please distribute the codes to registered attendees only; we’ll reconcile against the registrant export after the event.

Operational notes: 
- If you prefer Redwood to upload codes directly into HubSpot campaign, we can do that (we included the HubSpot campaign link below).
- If you expect any enterprise customers who need higher limits, send a separate list and we’ll evaluate per account.

HubSpot campaign: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HS-983241
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_campaign_assets

Thanks and good luck with the event — ping me if anything changes during distribution.

— Lauren
